notes.title: [UPDATE] Totally Unbalanced v1.1 is Here!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/487330/

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/totally616x353.png[/img]

[h1][b]Totally Unbalanced 1.1.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[b]NEW CONTENT![/b]
- NEW Soccer Mode! 
- Customize your team by selecting its name and color!
- 5v5 gameplay (will expand)

[b]Introducing the "Live Dashboard"[/b]
- Real-Time Stats of your SP and MP adventure
- Community spotlight!We will update them with the funniest Totally Unbalanced videos (we will contact you) 

[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
- We added the leaderboards (yay!Finally!)
- Everytime you finish a level, the game will upload the score
- Use the button "Leaderboards" in the dashboard or at the end of the level to see other players scores!

- Bug Fixes for Sumo and BallRace

[b]PERFORMANCE FIXES[/b]
- Introducing Epic's [b]Forward Rendering[/b]
- You should get 30-40 FPS more in-game
- We will also put the Deferred Rendering option for people that can't run Forward Rendering.

[b]MISC[/b]
- Updated with latest UE4 patches

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We still have ground to cover, expect new content and platform support very soon.

Also we're looking into dedicated servers!

[h1][b]Enjoy![/b][/h1]

[b]Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.[/b]
[h1]IsoJumper & OtakuMaker.com Studio[/h1]

notes.title: [UPDATE] v1.0.4 : Changes/Fixes are Here! + Additional Map
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/487330/

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/totally616x353.png[/img]

[h1][b]Totally Unbalanced 1.0.4 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[b]SINGLEPLAYER[/b]
- Changed the way the airscrew on the capsule rotates so FPS doesn't affect it too much.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
- Added a map to SUMO MODE and to BALL RACE MODE

[b]MULTIPLAYER SUMO[/b]
- Reworked the Math of the Physics when balls collide,this should make "ball-pushing" more fun and accurate
- Added a cooldown when the ball gets pushed of 1.0 seconds.

[b]MULTIPLAYER BALLRACE[/b]
- Fixed a bug that allowed players after 16 falls to not spawn

[b]UI[/b]
- Fixed a bug where text wouldn't display on the "Failed To Find Session" screen.

[b]MISC[/b]
- Engine synced with latest Epic Fixes(Performance,Network have been improved.)
- The Game doesn't indicate engine version anymore in Main Menu but displays a BUILD ID

[h1][b]Enjoy![/b][/h1]

[b]PLEASE NOTE :[/b]Update will go live at 18:00 (GMT +1)

[b]Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.[/b]
[h1]IsoJumper & OtakuMaker.com Studio[/h1]

notes.title: [UPDATE]1.0.3 Is Now Live!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/487330/

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/totally616x353.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

we pushed the 1.0.3 update,if you don't see it restart Steam.

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

Singleplayer :
-Fixed an issue where the ball could fall out of the capsule(CH1 / CH2)
-Fixed an issue where the puzzle would be active but still white
-Fixed an issue where pressing ESC at the end of the level screen would cause everything to glitch
-Fixed an issue where on slow computers the ball could spawn on the capsule

Multiplayer :
-Completely re-written core game code for SumoMode and BallRace mode
-Fixed various issues with the final UI
-Fixed a bug where players could ready,quit and still be "Ready"

Misc and UI:
-Performance improvements via server-side multiplayer
-New Buttons with new animations
-Multi-language support(only english is implemented at the moment)
-Changed texture for the popups
-Improved some text
-Improved session joining

Thank you to everyone who helped us find the bugs!We really appreciate them! :)

IsoJumper & OtakuMaker.com
